thread:
Iris: Quick sync — after last week's launch we need to lock the next minor's scope. Running low on runway, propose we batch low-risk enhancements and leave high-risk infra changes for later.
Daniel: Agreed. Can we make a 20m rubric: Severity (P0/P1/P2), Customer Impact (number of customers), Effort (S/M/L)?
Priya: +1. I'll pull customer tickets and map to affected orgs.
Ethan: Dev note: any change touching routing or model config often balloons. Flag those as "investigate" not immediate include.
Iris: Decision anchors I want: P0 -> hotpatch, P1 w/ >2 enterprise customers -> consider hotpatch, everything else -> next minor/backlog.
ops-bot: Telemetry: 14 new release-tagged errors since 03:00 UTC. Top: tokenization-mismatch (47), rate-limit-rush (22), ui-dup (9).
Daniel: I'll run a quick heatmap against error rate and unique users.
Priya: Mapping done for customer tickets: 5 customers reported auth flakiness, 2 reported streaming delays. Adding labels in the tracker.
Ethan: Can we avoid a hotpatch unless it's clearly customer-blocking? Hotpatch churn hurts momentum. Prefer canary + quick rollback.
Iris: Good point. Only hotpatch if P0 or SLA-breach risk. Otherwise aim for next minor with a clear owner and test plan.
Daniel: Suggested owners: auth flakiness -> Priya, streaming delays -> Ethan + infra; tokenization-mismatch -> ML infra team.
Priya: T-shirt sizing: auth flakiness = M (investigate + fix), streaming delays = S (config tweak) unless trace shows model-level issue.
Ethan: I'll start infra traces for streaming delays now. ETA 3h for initial RCA.
Iris: Action items:
- Priya: attach ticket mapping + customer list (due 4h)
- Daniel: produce heatmap and prioritized list (due 2h)
- Ethan: RCA trace for streaming delays (due 3h)
- Iris: run a 20m grooming after those items to finalize scope (in 4.5h)
Priya: Added labels: hotpatch-candidate (only auth if confirmed P0), next-minor, backlog-low. Also flagged two enterprise customers for comms.
Daniel: Quick note: include mitigation plan for any P1 we defer — e.g., circuit breaker, customer workaround doc.
Iris: Agreed. We'll draft customer comms if an enterprise is impacted >24h. Otherwise internal follow-up.
Ethan: If RCA shows model-serving latency, we'll need 2-day cycle. Marked as potential L effort.
Iris: Thanks — short grooming in 4.5h. If anything changes, ping here.
